messages:
Harper (product): Quick GA note: Hosted Async Generate is now GA. Designed for long-running inference (code analysis, multi-step tool workflows, and batch document transforms). Endpoint: POST /v1/async/generate. Docs & migration checklist: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/async-generate

Eli (eng-runtime): Short summary: async jobs return a job_id immediately. Clients poll /v1/async/status/:job_id or use webhook callbacks. Streaming per-job progress events available via the status endpoint. This helps keep client connections lightweight for multi-minute runs.

Nora (infra): New billing metric: compute-minutes for async runs (billed per-second with a 1s min). You'll see compute-minutes and wall-time in Cost Explorer. Be mindful of long-running tool chains.

Kai (security): Important policy change for tool-calls inside async jobs: callbacks to customer webhooks must be signed and the org must opt-in. Console -> Security -> Webhook Tooling: set a webhook secret. If a job requests a webhook call and the org has no secret, job will emit TOOL_CALL_BLOCKED and not execute external callbacks.

Jo (devex): SDK updates: @redwood/sdk-js v6.0.0 and @redwood/sdk-py v6.0.0 add async.generate(), async.status(), and helpers for webhook signatures (verifyWebhookSignature()). Update sample apps.

Eli (eng-runtime): New headers: X-RW-Async-Priority: low|normal|high influences queue placement and preemption behavior. X-RW-Webhook-Mode: off|signed|unsigned controls webhook invocation preference (requires org opt-in for signed). Example curl to start an async job:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/async/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -H 'X-RW-Async-Priority: high' \\n  -d '{"model":"rwd-async-1","input":"Analyze codebase for license issues","notify_webhook":"https://example.com/callback","stream_progress":false}'
```

Kai (security): For enterprises: webhook signing is mandatory unless you explicitly opt out. Also enable the 'tool-calls require audit-contact' flag for tighter controls. We'll surface enforcement details in Console when you enable.

Nora (infra): Rollout plan: canary us-central1 -> eu-west-3 -> ap-south-1 over 36h. OpsBot: rollout:async-generate v1 -> canary:us-central1 \u2705 started at 1823456801, est completion 1823463601. Monitor async.job_failure_rate and async.queue_wait_time.

Harper (product): Action items: 1) Update customer quickstarts to use async helpers, 2) Notify enterprise accounts about compute-minute billing, 3) Ensure webhook secrets are set for customers using callbacks. Reply here when done.

Jo (devex): I'll open PRs to patch example repos and the tutorial by EOD.

Eli (eng-runtime): Troubleshooting tips: if jobs stay in QUEUED >5min, check X-RW-Async-Priority and org quota. Use Model-Alias header to pin to a specific variant for reproducible latency.

Harper (product): TL;DR: Async GA for long-running workloads, new compute-minutes billing, webhook signing + opt-in for tool callbacks, SDK 6.0.0. Thanks team 389 escalate any customer-impacting issues to #eng-sre.
